item.label: balanced
item.justification: Results grew and the revenue outlook was raised, but management spent much of the call on headwinds: component lead times, mid-market price competition, technician wage inflation and an open renewal with its largest customer. Positive numbers combined with several openly named risks make the tone balanced.
